Meet our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. iPhone 18 Pro breaks new ground with a variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, delivering better low-light photos and video and sharper detail throughout the scene. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Capture sweeping landscapes and stunning macro photos in super-high-resolution detail.
Frame your shot in more flexible ways. Go from portrait to landscape without moving your iPhone. And fit more people in the frame automatically.

paragraphs: Make it cinematic. After the fact.

iPhone 18 Pro lets you add Cinematic mode effects to regular video — even after you shoot — so any moment can feel like a movie. Support for 60 fps makes slo-mo smooth. And with Audio Mix, you can isolate a musical performance from its surroundings, so every note comes through clearly.
The iPhone 18 Pro camera system improves low-light video at night or indoors by intelligently adjusting aperture and frame rate for brighter, clearer footage.
Record in more detail with support for 4K resolution with Dolby Vision HDR.
Audio Mix now lets you separate music and voices from unwanted background noise in your videos.
Built for filmmakers and content creators, with pro tools like ProRes RAW and Apple Log 2 for color grading, genlock for multicamera sync, and 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision for cinema-quality HDR footage.
Record yourself and the world around you with simultaneous front and rear video capture.

headings: There’s a new Pro in charge.
paragraphs: Best iPhone battery life.4 Greatest of hour time.
Up to30 hours of useper charge on iPhone 18 Pro Max7

iPhone 18 Pro Max delivers a massive leap in battery life with up to 45 hours of video playback — 6 more hours than iPhone 17 Pro Max. And with more battery capacity and greater efficiency, you’ll have up to 30 hours of use per charge for more streaming, gaming, and browsing, day or night.7

Thanks to faster wired charging, iPhone 18 Pro reaches up to 50 percent battery life in around 15 minutes.8 And now you can get up to 7 hours of video playback in 5 minutes on iPhone 18 Pro Max8 — great for a quick top-off before a long flight.
Up to50% charge in around 15 minuteswith compatible power adapter8

headings: Bigger vapor chamber. Let the heat drop.
paragraphs: Welcome to the mother chip.

A20 Pro is our most powerful and efficient iPhone chip design ever, with packaging inspired by our M-series chips. Working with the next‑generation vapor chamber, it gives you the best possible graphics performance — up to 40 percent faster than iPhone 17 Pro. And introduces a new Dual 16‑core Neural Engine with two times the compute for on‑device intelligence.5
More power for all your AI tasks. And faster Apple Intelligence thanks to new Neural Accelerators, a Dual 16‑core Neural Engine, and 50 percent higher memory bandwidth.
By placing the silicon die side by side with memory, the A20 Pro chip packaging drastically improves heat flow for significantly better thermal performance.

The next-generation vapor chamber has three times the surface area to dissipate even more heat. Combined with more thermally conductive materials, it works with the A20 Pro chip design to deliver up to 40 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 17 Pro. So you can push high-intensity gaming and run larger, more complex AI models on your device for longer.

headings: Meet Siri AI. Your AI assistant. More personal. More powerful.
paragraphs: Siri AI is rolling out in English.
Usage limits may apply.

Powered by Apple Intelligence, Siri AI is your conversational AI assistant with entirely new capabilities on iPhone.3 Ask open-ended questions, brainstorm ideas for work or creative projects on the go, and engage in natural, back-and-forth conversations.

Siri AI can find relevant answers to what you’re looking for just by asking. Search for a photo from years ago, easily locate an email buried in your inbox, or pull up a note you saved on your iPhone.

Siri AI can take actions in apps like Messages, Music, Reminders, and more based on what you’re doing in the moment. Quickly edit a message you just sent or add a song you hear in the car to your workout playlist.
Ask about virtually any topic that’s on your mind, from important facts to recipes and travel recommendations. Siri AI can reference information online to give you detailed, up-to-date insights.

A dedicated app brings together all your conversations in one place, so you can ask a question on your iPhone and pick up where you left off on your iPad. You can also pin conversations for easy access or start a new one.
Siri mode and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap.15
Pick a voice, then customize expressivity and pace until it clicks for you.16

Siri AI can now generate a draft from scratch or provide feedback on what you’ve written. Just describe what you need in your own words. And in Messages and Mail, Siri AI can match your writing style, punctuation, and tone.
